notes.statement: Source presentation order of formal 078 sub-tables is 01,02,03,04,05,06,10,11,12,14. It does not define tags 07/08/09/13 in this table or mandate sub-table ordering, uniqueness, or an unknown-tag policy.

The sample associates 001 with Unleaded and 019 with Diesel. These example associations are not a complete network product-code catalog. It also shows local amount 1500 as 15.00 and other amount 800 as 8.00.
Extended Unit of Measure definitions internally located in element 243: ACRE Acre; ARES Are; CELI Centiliter; CMET Centimeter; EACH Each; FOOT Foot.
Continuation of the internally located 36-code measurement list; GB and US volume code families retain their distinct source names.
Other Tax indicator text refers to national tax, while amount/rate titles say other tax. The example's national-tax tags are not the formal selectors 10/11/12.

Referenced segment 102 supports multiple fuels and places the vehicle's primary fuel first; fuel merchants send all applicable fuel/nonfuel codes with their product details. Its own notes require separators and product delimiters even for omitted fields. These are companion-segment constraints, not separators inside 078 TLV.

The source calls the tax-inclusive Standard Segment total Transaction Amount, but the referenced Standard layout separately names eight-byte Fuel Purchase Amount (41), Nonfuel Amount (58), Tax Amount (99), and Cash Amount (17). Fuel/nonfuel amounts are net of applicable discounts/coupons. Do not invent a Standard field literally named Transaction Amount or double-count the tax; the exact mapping of the 078 phrase to those components needs review.
